about: Authored kits for the classic teams (b778-ss1): installed by nfl2k5_classic_teams, not by the Anniversary moment stage, because the classic-teams preset has the Anniversary moments off. The moment-kit composer reads this shape exactly as data/nfl2k5_moment_kits.json.

kits.look: 2006 Sarasota Seamen from the SOFTDRINKTV Madden 07 episodes: teal jersey, sleeves and pants at home (white side panels, white pants stripe, light numbers), white jersey and pants on the road (teal side panels, teal pants stripe, dark teal numbers), white socks, white helmet with a teal centre stripe and a teal anchor on each side, teal facemask. Primary colour 009284 sampled from the Information screen.

ops.note: bright aqua highlight of the donor pants
